dessin: An official round seal like the seal on a certificate, completely neutral: a flat round seal with a scalloped wavy outer edge, a plain inner circle inside it, and two short ribbon tails with notched ends hanging below the seal. In the inner circle, only a small simple geometric rosette of thin ink lines. Ink #23281F outlines, fill pale #FBFCF8. No flag, no maple leaf, no crown, no coat of arms, no animal, no star, no national or provincial emblem, no letters, no numbers.
